datum: Overall width from the back of the run widest fixed collar to the branch collet outer face.
moving_feature: The small outermost terminal ring, furthest in the extended direction.
user_statement: 30.5 extended, 29 collet pressed. It is the outermost donut which slides, the furthest in the “extended” direction. This is obviously not the largest donut, in fact it is one of the smallest.

derived_nominal_stations.qualification: Derived using the nominal 8.15 mm back-collar radius. The conservative 8.25 mm envelope is not the caliper datum. Raw measured widths remain authoritative.

unresolved: Exact axial boundary of the moving terminal ring.
